### 1. Model & Dataset Overview

This audit was conducted on a `logistic_regression` model trained on the `compas` dataset. The protected attribute under examination is `race`, with `1` designated as the privileged group and `0` as the unprivileged group. The model was trained with a `random_seed` of `42`. A preprocessing mitigation technique, `correlation_remover`, was applied to address potential fairness issues.
